relationships.subject: carbamazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: the sodium channel blockers carbamazepine and oxcarbazepine, whose mechanism of action is to stabilize the inactivated state of sodium channels

relationships.subject: gabapentinoids
relationships.evidence_quote: Second-line treatments include gabapentinoids, which act on Cavα2δ subunits of high voltage activated calcium channels to inhibit synaptic transmission in the trigeminal pain pathway

key_findings: Reviews emerging trigeminal neuralgia therapies: CGRP receptor inhibition, TRPV1 activation/desensitization, new sodium channel blockers and botulinum toxin.
Larger well-controlled cohort studies are needed to confirm benefit.
